messages:
emily: Quick q — we're about to ship a small runtime hotpatch (perf/mem leak fix). Should we pin this as a patch or bump minor? also do we need a formal rollforward window?

jon: If it's only a perf/memory leak and no public API change, patch (`x.y.z`) is appropriate. Does anyone expect client-visible behavior diffs?

anya: Agree patch. Also +1 to pinning the infra image in the tag so autosyncs don't sneak in a minor image bump. :+1:

mike: Deploy-bot has a rule that auto-promote to `stable` only happens for patch bumps. Can we tag `v1.8.3-hotfix.1` instead of `v1.8.3`?

release-ops: We try to keep production tags as normal semver where possible. Prefer `v1.8.3` for an immediate hotfix. Pre-release suffixes are reserved for private testing. Also include a concise release note: `Fix: memory leak in runtime-scheduler`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for `v1.8.3` on `infra-pool-2` — rollout id rb-2026-03-20-12. Monitoring hooks activated. :eyes:

emily: If canary is green, can we set a 2h rollforward? runtime caches can take a bit to stabilize so leaning longer than our usual 1h.

jon: If the issue is KV-cache warm and RSS creep, I'd do 4h to be safe. Also add the rollback runbook link in the release note: https://internal/runbooks/hotpatch-rollback

anya: Also pin the model-serving image in the release manifest: `image: redwood/runtime:1.8.3` and the infra AMI so nothing auto-rolls underneath.

mike: Quick Q: do we mark changelog with `BREAKING:`? This isn't breaking, so no.

release-ops: I'll flip the deploy-bot setting to disallow auto-promote for 24h after successful rollout. That prevents downstream channels from picking it up until we've observed traffic.

sre-bot: sre-bot: Alerting policy check complete. No new policies needed; will monitor `token-fanout-error-rate` and `kv-cache-miss` dashboards during rollout.

emily: Sounds like consensus: patch bump to `v1.8.3`, pin images, 4h rollforward window, disable auto-promote for 24h, include rollback runbook in notes. I'll author the release note and tag.

mike: :thumbsup: tagging now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Tagged `v1.8.3` by @emily — commit abcd1234. Canary in progress (rb-2026-03-20-12).

jon: If canary fails, rollback steps (short): `kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime -n prod --to-revision=<prev>` and restore pinned image/manifest; escalate to eng-oncall if errors persist.

anya: Adding a compact release note template we should paste into release tracker:

```
Release: v1.8.3
Type: patch
Notes:
- Fix: memory leak causing increased RSS during long-running inference.
Rollforward window: 4h (monitoring: token-rate, kv-cache-hit, rss)
Rollback: https://internal/runbooks/hotpatch-rollback
Pinned images: redwood/runtime:1.8.3
```

emily: Posted the release note in the tracker and updated the deploy-bot annotation. Thanks team.

mike: Thanks — watching canary logs now.

sre-bot: sre-bot: Canary metrics look nominal at +15m. Will post 1h summary.
